==Details==

==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
{{Checklist|
*Speak to [[Curator Haig Halen]] in the [[Varrock Museum]]. {{Chat option|1Have you any interesting news?|1Sign me up!}}
}}

===The finishing touches===
{{Checklist|
*Go to the [[canal barge]] north of The Digsite and speak to the [[barge foreman]].
*Speak to the [[sawmill operator]] in the [[Lumber Yard]]. {{Chat option|3I'm here on behalf of the museum archaeological team.}}
*Bring the [[sawmill proposal]] to the sawmill operator in the [[Woodcutting Guild]]. {{Chat option|3I'm here on behalf of the museum archaeological team.}}
**If you don't have the requirements to enter, just try and open the eastern gate of the guild to complete this step.
*Bring the [[sawmill agreement]] back to the Lumber Yard's sawmill operator. {{Chat option|3I'm here on behalf of the museum archaeological team.}}
}}

===The cursed voyage===
{{Checklist|
*Speak to the [[barge foreman]].
*Right click the ''Embark'' option on the [[barge guard]].
*Speak to the [[Lead Navigator]]. {{Chat option|1Yep, that would be me.|2I'm aware, no need to tell me about them.}}
*Talk to [[Jack Seagull]] in the [[Rusty Anchor Inn]] in [[Port Sarim]]. {{Chat option|2Ever made any cursed voyages?}} or {{Chat option|3Ever made any cursed voyages?}}
*Return to the northern part of the digsite and board the boat through the barge guard.
*Talk to the [[Lead Navigator]].
*Speak to the [[Odd Old Man]] at the limestone mine to the north. You can get there by deboarding the boat and walking west, north, then east. {{Chat option|1Talk about lucky charms.|2I'm making a cursed voyage.}} He will give you the [[Bone charm]].

*Speak to the [[Apothecary]] in Varrock. Bring your two bottles of [[vodka]] and your [[Marrentill potion (unf)]]
**Chat options depend on quests completed. Pick ''Talk about something else.'', then pick ''Talk about Bone Voyage''.
*Speak to him again, selecting the same chat options as before.
*Return to the [[Lead Navigator]] to give him the [[potion of sealegs]].
*Speak to the [[Junior Navigator]] to give him the [[bone charm]]. {{Chat option|1I'm ready, let's go.}}
}}

[[File:Barge controls.png|thumb|The barge controls.]]

===The "cursed" voyage===
{{Checklist|*You will have to steer left or right using the controls on the interface. The progress bar will indicate how far you have to go to reach the island.
When the top arrow tilts to the left, click on the right arrow.

When the top arrow tilts to the right, click on the left arrow.

Changing the height of the sails will alter how drastically the boat shifts from side to side. Having the boat's sails as large as possible when going in a straight line will allow for a more consistent travel route.
*Once the progress bar is filled, you will arrive at Fossil Island.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
